author: Harrier Studio
title: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Looking for people to grow in comics and illustration. Open positions: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV and portfolio to harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portofolio). Open until all positions are filled.

title: Looking for artists to join Illustrator pool
content: We're looking for some incredible artists to join our Illustrator pool! Tap the link in bio to apply. Our illustrator pool is used for articles, newsletters, social media posts etc. Illustrators will be chosen and reached out to as needed. Contact: link in bio on Instagram @truchargv

author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic/character visual design collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer to collaborate on visual design for an exhibition planned for early December at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, logotype, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, one banner flag, and other exhibition derivatives, plus print proofing. Timeline: early Oct first draft of main visual and logotype; mid-Oct lock; early Nov all print-ready assets; mid-Nov to print; early Dec exhibition. Seeking someone with exhibition/graphic design experience and a hand-drawn, Japanese, warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote. Contact: comment or DM @willai3213 on Threads.
